# Decryption Tutorial

The Decryption API tutorial shows you how to fetch an encryption key in the XQ key store and use the encryption key to decrypt a message.

<!-- theme: warning -->
> #### This tutorial is not a sandbox!
>
> Any operations here behave as if you executed them from our own server.


### What to expect in this tutorial
This tutorial contains two sections. Each section contains details on the API call required to complete the section of the tutorial. After finishing this tutorial, you will be able to use your stored encryption key to decrypt a message.

Refer to the following descriptions for an overview of each section of the tutorial:

#### Section 1 - Fetching your encryption key
In this section of the tutorial you will use the locator and authorization token you received from the Encrption API tutorial. With this information, you will fetch the encryption key.

#### Section 2 - Decrypting your message
In this section you will decrypt your message.
